summary: EAT is a -25% drawdown name with a fundamentally STRONG underlying business — Chili's delivered 20 consecutive quarters of same-store sales growth, FY25 revenue +22% YoY, operating income +123% YoY, 9mo FY26 net income +29% YoY, guidance RAISED twice. Balance sheet is pristine: revolver paid to zero, $57M cash, $350M of 8.25% notes callable July 2026, clean KPMG audit, 97.7% governance approval. However, the Form 4 tape is unambiguously bearish on a relative basis: ZERO open-market purchases by any officer/director/10%+ holder in 12mo, against $33.4M of insider sales (208,880 sh). CEO Hochman alone sold $17.5M, including 66,000 shares @ $160.31 on 2026-01-29 — the calendar day AFTER his own Q2 FY26 earnings beat and guidance raise. Within 14 days of that beat, the entire C-suite (CFO Ware, CMO Felix, CLO Fuller, COO White, COO Comings) plus directors (Hood, Katzman) collectively sold $16.6M — a coordinated 'sell the news' cluster. Meanwhile, the company itself executed $300M of buybacks in 9mo at avg ~$137/sh while insiders sold at avg ~$160/sh — i.e., the buyback funds the insider exit. The single counter-signal is FMR/Fidelity accumulating from 5.21M sh (11.7%) at 12/31/2025 to 6.53M sh (15.0%) at 3/31/2026 — a +1.3M sh / ~$200M institutional accumulation INTO the drawdown. Mode B catches: (1) insider sell cluster timed precisely with bullish guidance raises [SEVERE], (2) Maggiano's segment traffic -10.5% YTD with margin halving, no impairment yet [MODERATE], (3) Chili's traffic turning negative in Q3 (-1.2%) despite favorable 'sustaining' framing [MODERATE], (4) buyback-funded insider exit asymmetry [MODERATE]. Disclosure quality is honest — no fraud, no covenant stress, no governance issues. The honesty-alpha read: the issuer is transparently strong but management's economic behavior contradicts their narrative of conviction. Severity: 2 PASS / 1 UNVERIFIABLE / 4 MODERATE / 1 SEVERE / 0 RED_FLAG. Verdict: NEUTRAL — the strong fundamentals, balance sheet, and Fidelity accumulation prevent SHORT-tier classification, but the unmistakable insider-vs-narrative divergence and Maggiano's deterioration prevent LONG-tier classification.
